artworks.title: Schwiegermutter (Mother-in-Law)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body sketch of a person seated with an arm resting on a surface. The individual is facing forward with their gaze directed slightly to one side. The facial features are detailed, with distinct lines highlighting the eyes and mouth. The person's hair is short and dark, contrasting against the lighter background. They are wearing a loose, textured garment, and the hand visible is at rest. There are no visible jewelry pieces or objects held. The backdrop is plain, focusing solely on the individual.

artworks.title: Gebeugter Akt (Nude Bending Forward)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from head to feet, depicted in a stooped position with one hand on their knee and the other arm extending forward. The person's facial features are expressive, with large eyes and a slightly open mouth, framed by short, dark hair. The figure is drawn with loose, dynamic lines, creating a sense of movement and form without specific clothing details. Strong shadows and textures are highlighted on the body, giving depth. The background is a plain, light-colored surface, possibly paper, with the artist's signature at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Alter Mann (Old Man)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an older person depicted from the waist up, seated in profile and slightly turned to the left. The person has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a lined face. They have sparse, combed-back hair and wear a coat with lapels. In the background, a sketch of another head and torso, possibly a second person, is on the left side. The background features a textured wall with a dark shaded rectangle. The strokes in the etching are rough, providing a dynamic texture. A signature is visible at the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Mönch mit Erhobenem Blick (Monk Gazing Upward)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Holland wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed drawing of a person's upper body, captured from the chest up. The individual is depicted in a semi-upright position with eyes pointing upward and lips slightly parted. Their facial features are distinct and textured with deep lines and shading. Their hair is covered with a hood attached to a dark cloak, partially concealing the shoulders. The person's hands are held close to the chest, fingers slightly splayed towards the neckline, conveying a sense of tension. The sketch-like style of the image on a plain background accentuates the figure's expressions and gestures. There are no visible accessories or objects aside from what the person holds, and the background lacks additional scenery or context.

artworks.title: Unter dem Kronleuchter (Under the Chandelier)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a large, ornate chandelier hanging from the ceiling, with multiple candle-like elements extending from it. The color palette consists of monochromatic shades, mainly black and white. The chandelier is positioned prominently in the upper half, casting its presence over a dimly lit room with scattered objects such as a lampshade and some items on a surface in the background.

artworks.title: Verschiedene Tierstudien (Animal Studies)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several animals depicted in simple, flowing lines. The composition features multiple sketched outlines of the animals, capturing a range of stances and movements. The use of light, swift strokes gives a sense of motion and fluidity to the forms. The simplicity of the sketching allows the viewer to focus on the graceful forms and movement of the animals.

artworks.title: Verschiedene Tierstudien (Animal Studies)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on J. W. Zanders laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows farm animals including a cow and several chickens. A large cow or calf is facing to the right, drawn with loose and fluid lines. Scattered around the cow are chickens, illustrated with similar energetic lines. The sketchy lines suggest quick observation, possibly done outdoors. The contrast between the solid form of the cow and the smaller shapes of the chickens adds a dynamic element to the composition.

artworks.title: Verschiedene Tierstudien (Animal Studies)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts farm animals including a cow, a rooster, and chickens in simple black lines on a cream background. The animals are portrayed with minimalistic and energetic line work, focusing on capturing their essence. The cow is at the top with its head turned towards the viewer, while chickens are at the bottom, suggesting a farmyard scene.

artworks.title: Gerhart Hauptmann
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man from the waist up, in a seated position with slightly turned shoulders facing the viewer. The man has a round face with prominent features, such as deep-set eyes, a broad nose, and a serious expression. He has short, somewhat disheveled hair and is dressed in a suit jacket with a buttoned shirt underneath. His hands are resting in front of him and the background is abstract, with vertical lines suggesting curtains or drapery. There is an artist's signature at the bottom, along with the year 1917.

artworks.title: Dünenlandschaft (Landscape with Dunes)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a distant landscape with a horizon slightly below the middle of the composition. Silhouettes of buildings and trees can be seen against the sky. In the foreground, loose strokes depict an open field with scattered marks. The brushstrokes are quick and suggestive. The color palette is monochromatic, using black shades against an off-white background. The sky is minimally depicted with subtle cloud-like lines.

artworks.title: Landschaft mit Kühen (Landscape with Cows)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape sketched with expressive lines, featuring trees in the foreground with swirling strokes. Beyond the trees are small, minimally depicted figures resembling cows. The horizon is positioned high with a horizontal line and a hint of a fence or distant building on the right. The sketch utilizes a monochromatic palette of black and white, emphasizing contrasts and textures.

artworks.title: Interieur mit Frau (Interior with Woman)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a woman from the waist up. She is seated and slightly turned to her left with her face turned towards the viewer. The woman has short, dark hair and a serious expression. She is wearing a patterned garment, possibly with floral designs, and a collar. In the background, there is a large plant to her left and some linear forms that may suggest windows or architectural details. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by the woman. The background includes abstract lines and shapes that contribute to the overall impressionistic rendering of the space.

artworks.title: Die Gattin (Wife of the Artist)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image includes a sketch of a seated person shown from the waist up. The person seems to be examining an object, with their head facing downwards in concentration. The facial features are minimally detailed, and the person appears to have short, dark hair. They wear a collared garment depicted with simple lines. An outline of a table lamp is visible to the left of the person, suggesting an interior setting. The background is roughly sketched, and there is a signature at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Das Kranke Kind (The Sick Child)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows an etched depiction of a person lying in a bed, with their upper body visible. The person is in a reclined position, resting their head on a pillow, with the face turned slightly towards the viewer. Their facial features appear serene, with eyes closed. The person's hair is dark and styled with a slight wave, framing the face. They are wearing a garment that seems to be a nightgown or similar attire. The bed is covered with a blanket or sheet that is drawn up to the person's chest. There are no visible jewelry items or objects being held by the person. The background consists of a simple setting, with the headboard of the bed visible, and the entire scene rendered in a sketch-like style with crosshatched lines providing texture and depth.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis an der Staffelei (Self-Portrait with Easel)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up. The person is standing and facing forward with their head slightly tilted down. They are engaged in drawing or writing on a pad or easel with a pencil or similar object in their hand. The person's facial features are partially obscured, showing a broad nose and closely trimmed or shaved head. They are wearing a suit with broad lapels. The background features abstract, linear drawings suggesting an interior setting with architectural elements or furnishings.

artworks.title: Schachspiel (Chess Players)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of three figures, only their upper bodies and heads visible. The figures are sitting close together. Their facial features are drawn in a rough style, with shadowed areas emphasizing their profiles. The figures' hair is depicted with simple lines. Clothing is suggested by lines enveloping their upper bodies. The background is plain, focusing attention on the figures.

artworks.title: A Young Woman Sewing [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on gray-blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Christian Humann Foundation, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a woman in profile. She is looking downward with her head slightly bowed, showcasing delicate facial features with closed eyes. Her hair is styled in loose waves with a floral or ribbon accessory. She is wearing a detailed dress with floral embellishments and is holding a piece of fabric. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Horseman Wearing a Grande Cockade [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on gray-blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Christian Humann Foundation, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The sketch depicts the back view of a person from head to mid-thigh level. The person is standing upright, facing forward with a slightly downward tilted head. They are wearing a large, wide-brimmed hat and a long, voluminous coat with visible folds and a high collar. There are no visible facial features, jewelry, or objects being held. The sketch is simple with minimal background details, focusing on the figure against a plain backdrop.

artworks.title: Tuft of Cowslips
artworks.medium: gouache on parchment
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: A clump of leaves with a few stems of tall, yellow blossoms are painted on a vertical sheet of tan-colored parchment. The leaves are long and rounded, with prominent, textured veining. A few blades of grass and sprigs of clover are interspersed among the dense clump of leaves. The cowslip blossoms are clusters of bell-shaped yellow petals at the end of a starburst-like formations of pale green tubes. The ground is painted an earthy gray, and the background is left blank. The artist dated the work, 1526, in the lower right corner over a monogram of his initials, AD.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over leadpoint with blind stylus on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: Five sketches in brown ink are spaced around a vertically oriented sheet of paper. In the top left quadrant, a bearded man faces our right in profile. He has short, curly hair, a deeply lined face, a pronounced underbite, and the tip of his long nose points down. Two independent, wrinkle-lined eyes are sketched in the top right quadrant of the page. Below are two drawings of women with their shoulders angled away from us to the right. Near the bottom left and smaller in scale, a woman looks over her shoulder at us with a slight smile on her lips. In the bottom right quadrant, a woman with her hair pulled back under a snood looks to our right in profile with her chin tipped up. The neckline of both women’s bodices dip across the shoulder blades in the back. The paper is speckled with faint brown stains and spots.

artworks.title: Study of a Madonna [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: A woman wearing a mantle, which drapes over her head and shoulders, and holding her hands together in prayer is lightly sketched in black chalk in this vertical drawing. Her body is angled to our left. Her head tips in that direction, and she looks off into the distance. Forms to the left of the woman are studies of a man’s torso and a muscular leg. The sketches are all faintly drawn on paper that now has some brown speckling.

artworks.title: Male Nude [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of a nude man standing. His upper body is turned slightly, with his head tilted downward and one foot raised. His facial features are not distinctly drawn, and he doesn't appear to have hair. His chest is lightly shaded with horizontal lines, and neither of his arms have hands. The background is plain beige paper.

artworks.title: Male Nude [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two abstract human figures. The figures are sketched with light strokes on textured paper. The figures stand close together, with an embrace or connected pose suggested by the composition. The outlines are faint and the details are minimal. The sketch conveys movement and intimacy through its lines and shading techniques.

artworks.title: The Prophets Hosea and Jonah
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over charcoal and blind stylus, heightened with white gouache and squared for transfer with blind stylus and red chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: Drawn with brown ink and shaded with tan washes on cream-white paper, two bearded men wearing robes, with a smaller, nude, winged boy between them, fill this vertical drawing. At the center top of the paper, the angel faces us, gazing down to our left with open mouth and eyebrows drawn together. He has curly hair and lifts his muscular right arm, on our left, with his index finger pointed upward. Crosshatched lines define his body, and quick, curved lines shade his outstretched wings. To our right, one man stands with his body facing the center of the sheet but he turns his head to look up off the top right corner. He has curling hair, a wide mustache, and perhaps a goatee, though his chin is partially hidden by a dark spot on the paper. He has broad shoulders, a thick neck, large hands, and a hint of a muscular leg under his flowing, voluminous robes. He holds a flat, oblong object, possibly a stone tablet, perched on his slightly bent left knee. Seated to our left, the other man faces and looks at us. He also grasps a flat, tablet-like object but holds it up, braced on his right thigh, to our left, and points to it with his other hand. This man also is solidly built and swathed in robes, with a hood over his curly hair. He leans forward, knees apart, and stares out with his brows deeply furrowed. His downturned mouth is set in a bushy, curly beard. Near the bottom of the picture, the bare feet of the two men emerge from the folds of their robes. Touches of white washes on the folds of the robes create a sense of light coming from above and to our right, and charcoal lines reinforce the shadows. A grid is lightly drawn in red chalk lines over the composition. A black stamp in the lower left has the letters “E.C” and another at the center reads, “H de T. STAT.”
